138:     if timestamps_weights is not None:
139:         timestamps_weights = be.asarray(timestamps_weights)
140:         res = timestamps_weights @ res / timestamps_weights.sum()
141:     else:
142:         res = res.mean(axis=0)
143: 
144:     if isinstance(multioutput, str):
145:         if multioutput == "uniform_average":
146:             res = res.mean()
147:     else:
148:         multioutput = be.asarray(multioutput)
149:         res = multioutput@res / multioutput.sum()
150:     return res
151: 
152: 
153: def mase(
154:     y_true,
155:     y_pred,
156:     train_data,
157:     seasonal_period=1,
158:     ts_weights=None,
159:     timestamps_weights=None,
160:     multioutput="uniform_average"
161: ):
162:     """
163:     Mean absolute scaled error (MASE)
164: 
165:     MASE is a measure of the prediction accuracy for forecasting and regression tasks that computes
166:     the scaled average of the deviations between ground truth and predicted values.
167: 
168:     The scaling factor is computed as the MAE of the naive m-seasonal forecast on the in-sample dataset.
169: 
170:     Parameters
171:     ----------
172:     y_true: array like, shape (n_ts, sz, d)
173:         Target dataset of ground_truth values
174:     y_pred: array like, shape (n_ts, sz, d)
175:         Estimated dataset of predicted values
176:     train_data: array like
177:         the in-sample dataset, used to compute the scaling factor
178:     seasonal_period: int (default: 1)
179:         seasonal period used to compute the scaling factor
180:     ts_weights: array like, shape (n_ts,) or None (default: None)
181:         Weights to apply to the time-series in the datasets if non-uniform.
182:         Use none for uniform weights.
183:     timestamps_weights: array like, shape (sz,) or None (default: None)
184:         Weights to apply to the timestamps of each-time series if non-uniform.
185:         Use none for uniform weights.
186:     multioutput: {'uniform_average', 'raw_values'} or array-like, shape (d,) (default: 'uniform_average')
187:         for multivariate timeseries, defines the aggregation of per feature results, if any.
188: 
189:         'raw_values':
190:             no aggregation, result is per feature
191:         'uniform_average':
192:             errors of all features are averaged with uniform weights
193:         array-like:
194:             errors of all features are averaged using the given weights
195: 
196:     Returns
197:     -------
198:     float or array-like, shape (d,)
199:         If multioutput is ‘raw_values’, then mean squared error is returned for each feature.
200:         Otherwise, the average of each feature is returned.
201: 
202:     """
203: 
204:     train_data = to_time_series_dataset(train_data)
205: 
206:     mae_ = mae(y_true, y_pred, ts_weights, timestamps_weights, multioutput)
207: 
208:     if multioutput == "raw_values":
209:         scale_axis = (0, 1)
210:     else:
211:         scale_axis = None
212:     scale = abs(train_data[:, :-seasonal_period] - train_data[:, seasonal_period:]).mean(axis=scale_axis)
213: 
214:     return mae_ / scale
